title: The Knight Beyond the Chalice
description: Fill the Great Chalice through its native essence mechanic, then use Radiant Essence on the full vessel. That interaction calls the Netherman; defeat what answers. Questlog observes only the resulting kill and does not replace Knight Quest's summoning sequence.
description_completed: The Netherman has answered the Great Chalice and fallen. Knight Quest's authored REIGN arc is complete; its remaining equipment and encounters stay native progression rather than becoming a duplicate checklist.
